title: Fotile — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Fotile.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Side-Draft Revolution." Fotile is Chinas largest kitchen ventilation brand, expanding into North America with their revolutionary side-draft (or under-cabinet) range hoods. Instead of overhead extraction, Fotile captures smoke and steam at the cooking surface before it rises — up to 90% capture efficiency. They also make dishwashers and steam ovens for the Asian cooking market.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Asian cooking households, open-concept kitchens where overhead hoods are impractical, design-forward kitchens.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Fotile:

• Side-draft design captures smoke at the source — 90% capture before it rises

• Perfect for wok cooking and high-heat Asian cuisine

• Auto-turbo mode detects smoke and increases power automatically

• Self-cleaning function — maintains performance without manual scrubbing

• Disruptive design that eliminates bulky overhead hoods in open kitchens
